title: Jeff Astle. The King.
deck: 174 goals, and one finish remembered above all.
body: Jeff Astle scored 174 goals in 361 Albion appearances. His 1968 FA Cup campaign included a goal in every round and the extra-time winner against Everton in the final.

The club’s profile remembers both a prolific centre-forward and a personality closely bound to West Bromwich. His place in the club’s memory is visible beyond the records: the Astle Gates turn the walk to the ground into a meeting with its past.
